title: Finite-limit and finite-colimit preservation transfer along a natural isomorphism
statement: Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be categories and $F,G:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ functors. Let $\theta:F\cong G$ be a natural isomorphism, that is, a family of isomorphisms $\theta_M:FM\to GM$ with $\theta_N\circ F(h)=G(h)\circ\theta_M$ for every $h:M\to N$. If $F$ preserves finite limits [def-galois-finite-limits-colimits], then $G$ preserves finite limits. If $F$ preserves finite colimits, then $G$ preserves finite colimits. Here preservation means sending every existing limiting cone, respectively colimiting cocone, indexed by a finite category to one with the same universal property.
